title: Records
intro: I work with many musicians and record labels; at [Electrecord](https://electrecord.ro) I am the leading designer for reissues. A selection of LPs from the past years, from iconic reissues to new releases: Draganenii “Elvis EP”, Trei Parale “România. 100 de minute.”, Romica Puceanu, Alexandru Andrieș, Grupul Stereo, Partizan, Aura Urziceanu, Ion Creangă and Lola Bobescu.
